A lot of scary things are going on in the world, and I hope that by taking part in #WhatAGameDevLooksLike next week you can create a little moment of camaraderie and joy. It's a tiny act of resistance. Despite all the nonsense in this industry, you belong here and you deserve to be celebrated. 💜

In 2019, I created #WhatAGameDevLooksLike after I was stopped by security 3(!!) times while picking up my speaker badge. I’m a small Asian woman with pink hair, and I guess I didn’t visually meet their expectations of a speaker. 

Ironically, I was at GDC to speak about inclusive studio cultures. 🫠

I started #WhatAGameDevLooksLike the next day. It was mostly for myself, but it became a lovely demonstration of how diverse all facets of our industry actually are. It challenges standard expectations of who makes games and it’s an easy way to celebrate and amplify the diversity in our industry.
